recentItems.title: Hawas Ki Intehaa (Full Movie) | Imran Khan, Komal Dhillon, Dev Singh | Bollywood Hindi Movie
recentItems.description:
Hawas Ki Intehaa (Hindi) Full Movie starring Imran Khan, Komal Dhillon, Dev Singh, Gayatri Singh, Akshita Tiwari, Meraj Khan, Baliram Gawad, Namrata Rathod, Miraj Khan, Sarita Nagar, Sushmita Raj, Mahua Mondal, Rakhi & Sabha.

Synopsis
अंधकारमय और खतरनाक, यह विनाशकारी पारिवारिक ड्रामा एक खुशहाल वैवाहिक जीवन जी रहे युवा दंपति के इर्द-गिर्द घूमता है। हालांकि, जब पत्नी गर्भवती हो जाती है, तो पति कामुक हो जाता है और अपनी पत्नी की पीड़ा और आक्रोश के बावजूद विवाहेतर संबंध बनाने लगता है।

दंपति का वैवाहिक जीवन उथल-पुथल भरा हो जाता है और उनकी बेटी एक अस्वस्थ वातावरण में पलने लगती है। जब वह बड़ी हो जाती है, तो उसे बोर्डिंग स्कूल भेज दिया जाता है ताकि उसे उसके पिता की जीवनशैली से दूर रखा जा सके। भाग्य के एक अजीब मोड़ पर, पति का एक दुर्घटना में लकवा हो जाता है, जिससे पत्नी को उससे बदला लेने और अपने विवाहेतर संबंध बनाने का मौका मिल जाता है। दुर्व्यवहार सहने के बाद, पति धीरे-धीरे कमजोर होता जाता है और दुखद मृत्यु को प्राप्त होता है।

जब उनकी बेटी बड़ी हो जाती है, तो वह गर्व से अपने प्रेमी को अपनी माँ से मिलवाने के लिए लाती है, लेकिन यह जानकर उसे गहरा सदमा लगता है कि वह आदमी उसकी माँ का पूर्व प्रेमी है। माँ और बेटी के भविष्य में क्या होगा?

Synopsis
The Peaceful Life in Lucknow: Raghava works as a head cook in a catering unit in Lucknow alongside his young son, Arjun. Both share a mild stammer and live a quiet, non-violent life.
The Inciting Incident: During a festive celebration, Raghava saves the life of a local politician, drawing the wrath of a rival faction led by villain Tripathi (Ravi Kishan).
The Underworld Reveal: When forced to defend his family, Raghava drops his mild demeanor and reveals his true identity as Robert, a former trusted enforcer for a powerful underworld don named Nanabhai (Jagapathi Babu).
The Past Connection: A deep flashback reveals that Robert used to work alongside his close friend Raghava (Vinod Prabhakar). After his friend and his wife were killed, Robert escaped with their infant son (raising him as his own Arjun) and vowed to leave violence behind.
The Final Showdown: Robert is pulled back into a high-stakes war against Nanabhai and rival syndicates, using clever strategy and intense action to protect his son and put his past to rest.

Synopsis
Aditya, played by Nani, is an aspiring assistant film director who is trying to make his mark in the film industry. While working in cinema, including alongside renowned director S. S. Rajamouli in a cameo appearance, Aditya meets Suma, played by Riya Suman. To impress her, he begins narrating a memorable love story from his hometown of Bheemavaram.

Years earlier, Aditya fell deeply in love with Kiranmayi, played by Anu Emmanuel, a college student whose heart gradually became close to his. To win her affection, Aditya even joined her college as a junior lecturer. Their beautiful relationship, however, faced a serious setback when a misunderstanding arose after Aditya chose to stand by his friend Kasi during a conflict. As Aditya recounts his past to Suma, he begins to understand that his feelings for Kiranmayi have never truly disappeared. Things become even more complicated when he discovers that Suma and Kiranmayi are cousins.
